facts: The Distressed Marketplace (/distressed) shows proof-gated listings for undervalued residency and citizenship pathways.
Every listing requires a Satohash proof — no proof, no listing. This is the proof-gate.
Two lanes: Kimi-curated (human-reviewed, gold-tier for flagships) and permissionless (auto-generated, verify proof first).
The distressed score (1-5) ranks listings by value: lower investment + higher sovereignty = higher score.
All asks are shown in Bitcoin first — the marketplace thinks in sats, not dollars.
The Escrow Builder generates a non-custodial 2-of-3 PSBT template (buyer, seller, arbiter) — template only, pre-launch.
Deal rooms are agent-mediated — escalate to Kimi via Nostr for high-stakes negotiations.
Red flags are honest warnings from the corpus — every listing shows them upfront.
Optimization tips come from the program's Paige fields — actionable advice for each pathway.
Bookmarks let you save listings for later — stored locally in localStorage.
Filters: region, minimum score, max BTC price, proof-gated only, bookmarks only.
Sort: by discount (score + gold tier), price (lowest first), or region (alphabetical).
Gold-tier curated listings are flagship programs (Uruguay, Bolivia, El Salvador, UAE, Portugal, Georgia) with proof + deep research.
Standard curated listings are high-score programs with proof but not flagship depth.
Permissionless listings are auto-generated from any program with a proof — buyer beware.
The marketplace links to Vault for proof verification, BTC Map for merchant density, and Apply for applications.
MotoPass does not custody funds — the escrow is a template, not a service.
Listings are built from countries.json pathway data — the same data powering the simulator and compare tools.

lanes.curated: Human-reviewed by Kimi. Gold tier = flagship programs with proof + deep research. Standard = high-score with proof.
lanes.permissionless: Auto-generated from any program with a Satohash proof. Verify the proof first — buyer beware.
lanes.all: Shows both curated and permissionless listings.

scoring.method: distressed_score (1-5) based on: lower investment = higher score, budget/value keywords = bonus, low sovereignty = bonus, flagship depth = bonus, gold-curated = bonus.
scoring.interpretation: 4-5 = strong value, 3 = moderate, 1-2 = standard. Always verify the proof regardless of score.

pages./distressed: Marketplace with listings, filters, sort, bookmarks, and listing modals
pages./agents: Agent grid — escalate to Kimi for deal room negotiations
pages./vault: Verify proofs before committing to any listing
pages./apply: Apply with a proof attached from the listing
pages./btcmap: Check merchant density in the listing's jurisdiction

honesty_rules: Every listing requires a Satohash proof — no proof, no listing.
Permissionless listings are auto-generated — verify the proof independently.
MotoPass does not custody funds — the escrow is a PSBT template, not a service.
Red flags are honest warnings — read them before acting.
The distressed score is a heuristic — it does not guarantee investment quality.
Gold-tier means Kimi reviewed it — but still verify the proof yourself.
Deal rooms are agent-mediated — Kimi facilitates, but the deal is between buyer and seller.
